measurementNotes: Main, fresh round 1 and round 2 use matching Lighthouse 13.6.0 default simulated mobile settings on actual production builds served by next start; three sequential fresh Chrome/profile/storage-reset runs per page, no request blocking.

Before each page batch, initial HTML and all src/srcset/imagesrcset image-optimizer URLs are warmed with Chrome AVIF Accept and response bodies consumed. Initial default-Accept main runs are preserved separately and excluded.
Builds enable NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSISTANT_CHAT=1 and disable ASSISTANT_VOICE; public chat is verified in initial server HTML. No .env or credentials copied into detached main.
Laptop/runtime scheduling noise remains visible even under simulation. All runs and benchmark indices are retained; isolated favorable runs do not establish a passing batch.
LCP insight subparts are measured trace durations. They do not add to simulated scored LCP. Diagnostic model remainder arithmetic is separately labeled.

The measured fresh round-1 median is 34ms faster than main on home and 457ms slower on mobile welding; the preload-only probe does not rule out the total cost of typography or establish this service difference's cause.
Production-host gating suppresses external analytics on localhost. Source inspection establishes deferred external loading, but local Lighthouse cannot measure live-provider transfer cost.

No behavior-preserving product optimization showed a reliable gain; no product source change was retained. A measured current-build range/median is not a universal lower bound across future architectures.

diagnosis.finding: Main already fails the median target without IBM Plex. Both LCP elements are eager high-priority preloaded AVIF hero images. Core Next/React startup and initial script/network work dominate the remaining simulated render remainder; no large avoidable pre-LCP app callback was found.
diagnosis.fontLoading: Four Latin faces actually download: Barlow Condensed 900, one variable IBM Plex Sans face, IBM Plex Mono 500/600. Body/display preload, Mono loads when used; active faces swap, marker optional and not downloaded. Four font resources total 74360 bytes. Removing only the Sans preload while retaining display preload shows no reliable gain; this does not isolate total typography cost.
diagnosis.css: Two stylesheet responses transfer 35631 bytes and decode to 163648 bytes (149504 public CSS, 7444 font CSS, 6700 chat CSS). Critical-only and delayed-full-CSS probes improve FCP but worsen LCP; rejected.
diagnosis.js: Representative audited script transfer is 180673 home / 197513 service bytes, including modules loaded after LCP; about 27KB of unused code belongs to the 71KB compressed framework chunk. Core startup dominates script work; form module imports after observed LCP and full chat imports on first open.

startupDiagnostic.externalJsBlocked: Actual local-server origin with blockedUrlPatterns ['*.js']; inline scripts still execute
startupDiagnostic.interpretation: Diagnostic estimate/bound from one run per page compared with the proxy control, not an exact causal/removable cost or a behavior-preserving production floor.

diagnosis.analytics: Only small inline queue/config bootstrap is afterInteractive. External Google waits for pointer/keyboard/touch/scroll interaction or an 8-second fallback. Meta observes that same script insertion. Host gating excludes providers on localhost, so no live analytics transfer claim is made; early conversion queue/DNI/listeners unchanged.
